english.dragInstructions: Press Space or Enter to pick up this answer choice. Once picked up, use Tab or Shift+Tab to cycle through response areas, or use arrow keys to move it freely. Press Space or Enter to drop, or Escape to cancel.
english.commonCorrectAnswerWithAlternates: Note: The answer shown above is the most common correct answer for this item. One or more additional correct answers are also defined, and will also be recognized as correct.
english.readingInstructions: Build a sorted list by moving each object to the correct position. Use TAB to move between objects and drop areas, ENTER to select/drop, and ESC to cancel.

objectsAreOnSortedList.one: {sorted} of {total} object is on the sorted list.
objectsAreOnSortedList.other: {sorted} of {total} objects are on the sorted list.

english.useTabToObject: Use TAB to move to an object.
english.unsortedObjectFocus: Unsorted object {text} Press ENTER to select or TAB to move to a different object.
english.sortedObjectFocus: Sorted object {text} In position {position} of {total}. Press ENTER to select or TAB to move to a different object
english.emptyPositionFocus: On sort position {position} of {total}, which is empty. Press ENTER to move selected object {text} here or use TAB to move to a different position.
english.occupiedPositionFocus: On sort position {position} of {total}, which contains object {occupant}. Use TAB to move to a different position or press ENTER to move the selected object {text} here, which will return the object currently in sort position {position} to unsorted.
english.unsortedListReturnFocus: On unsorted list. Press ENTER to return selected object {text} to unsorted or use TAB to move to a sort position.
english.unsortedListLeaveFocus: On unsorted list. Press ENTER to leave object {text} unsorted or use TAB to move to a sort position.
english.selectedUnsorted: Selected object {text} Use TAB to move to a sorted position.
english.selectedSorted: Selected object {text}, which is in sort position {position} of {total}. Use TAB to move to a different position.
english.placed: Placed object {text} in sort position {position} of {total}.
english.moved: Moved object {text} from sort position {from} to sort position {to}.
english.returnedToUnsorted: Object {text} has been returned to unsorted list.

answerComplete.one: Answer is complete. {total} of {total} object on sorted list.
answerComplete.other: Answer is complete. {total} of {total} objects on sorted list.

english.useTabToAnotherObject: Use TAB to move to another object.
